label: A. CONSOLIDATION NOT WORTHWHILE
summary: No meaningful FPGA capacity is recovered: the paired production-settings experiment uses27more placed ALMs and only10fewer needed ALMs. The single seed2 sensitivity check fails setup. Production remains v17.
timingRouting: Primary seed1 completed map/fit/asm/STA with zero errors, zero failing timing summary categories and no routing failure. Setup improves by+0.260ns and hold by+0.027ns in that one fit. Average/peak routing use is40%/59%; the seed2 confirmation routes at39%/60% but fails setup. This does not establish a robust timing benefit.
pathAnalysis: The primary global worst setup path moves from HDMI shadowmask dout[20] ->HDMI OSD nrdout1[20] (+0.105ns) to HDMI scaler o_vacpt[9] ->o_vpixq_pre[3].g[7] (+0.365ns). Primary worst hold is in VDP2 sprite shifter shift0[6] ->shift0[7] (+0.233ns). The emulation-clock worst setup improves from+0.635ns to+1.162ns, remaining an SDRAM-to-CPU path: baseline sd_dat[8] ->T80 IR[4], primary sd_dat[11] ->T80s DI_Reg[1]_OTERM325. Neither ten-worst emulation report contains the savestate controller. [Baseline emulation paths](baseline_emu_setup.rpt), [primary emulation paths](experiment_emu_setup.rpt). These are global placement/routing effects in unchanged source hierarchies, not evidence that development-version decode was the critical path. Confirmation returns a failing HDMI-output path at−0.013ns.

costReason: The paired seed1 build reduces needed ALMs by10 (0.024percentage points of device capacity) while increasing placed ALMs by27 (0.064points); there is no placed capacity recovery. Only8mapped control registers disappear. Fitted registers fall102, with no M10K, memory-bit or DSP recovery. Whole-design logic ALUT usage falls171 while route-through ALUT usage rises162. Shared current/public restore paths and modern state banks dominate the retained cost. Seed2 shows only a small, unpaired placement movement and fails setup, so the primary timing gain is not robust.
reason: The public floor is strongly supported and the current/public functional gate passes, but the required meaningful resource-cost/capacity-recovery condition is not demonstrated. A code cleanup or one favorable timing placement does not justify a production format change for the stated capacity objective. Choose A and stop after investigation.
noProduction: The experiment does not recover material placed capacity, and the single confirmation does not preserve the timing improvement. Production consolidation is therefore not justified by the evidence. Both released reader families and all existing v17 behavior remain in the untouched production tree.
next: Keep the committed v17 production configuration and resume the next separately scoped functional roadmap task, with resource and STA checks against the retained baseline. Carry the verified public64/public96 history forward for any later format-consolidation decision. G08.FM remains open; this audit does not close it.
